title: Flavor Switcher
description: Drink landing page where the background, ink and giant flavor word blend between flavors as you drag the cans.
steps: `itemAnimation` spaces the cans 40% of the screen width apart (`itemSize` is half the width), tilting neighbors `14°`, scaling them to `0.62` and fading the next ones out.
The carousel writes `progress` every frame; `interpolateColor` blends the background and ink between the current and next flavor, and the flavor words slide `0.9` screen widths per item.
Each can's two fruit slices read `relativeProgress` and drift and spin against the motion, while `onSnapToItem` swaps the name, note and calories.
